title: Glitch-Free Reactive DAG Engine & Dynamic Unsubscription
prompt:
Fix the reactive dependency tracking, propagation ordering, and cycle recovery bugs in this incremental computation engine.

Reported issues:
1. Diamond glitching: when `A` updates and `D` depends on both `B(A)` and `C(A)`, `D` recomputes multiple times per update and its subscribers observe inconsistent intermediate `(new B, old C)` states — both on direct `set()` and inside `batch()`.
2. Stale dependency leaks: when a conditional `computed` switches branches (e.g. `flag.get() ? a.get() : b.get()`), changing the previously-read cell still triggers spurious recomputations of the computed cell and can trigger false cycle errors.
3. Non-recoverable cycle errors: if updating a cell introduces a dependency cycle, throwing a cycle error leaves internal node state corrupted so catching the error and reverting the condition fails to recover clean evaluation.

Inspect the codebase and run `node --test test/public.test.ts` to verify baseline behavior.
